profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I am a software engineer at Facebook and a graduate of Washington University in St. Louis with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with a minor in Psychology. I have several years of experience with assistant teaching, public speaking, club leadership, and community service. My proficient programming languages include Java and JavaScript, but I've also worked with PHP/Hack, C++, and MySQL. While I'm still exploring the many different disciplines within CS, I have a special interest in working around the intersection of psychology, education, and technology.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
CSE 132: Computer Science II (Head TA), CSE 131: Computer Science I, CSE 247R: Seminar in Data Structures and Algorithms
Assist students with learning about coding basics, digital and analog I/O and object-oriented project design through projects in Java and Arduino C/C++
Attend all assigned class periods, hold office hours, and answer questions through Piazza
Responsible for grading student assignments and exams with other teaching assistants

company.name: Washington University McKelvey School of Engineering

positions.title: Learning Assistant
positions.description:
Aided with leading and planning classroom instruction over basic computer science languages and concepts, including HTML & CSS, JS, Scratch, and Python
Managed a classroom of 20-30 students aged 10-13 years old

positions.title: Office of Undergraduate Admissions Intern
positions.description:
Served as a representative of Washington University in St. Louis for prospective students
Led daily tours of the campus
Co-presented information sessions with an Admissions Officer
Conducted daily interviews with prospective students
Completed group projects and presenting findings
Assisted with office work

honors.title: Outstanding Junior in Computer Science
honors.description: One of five juniors recognized by the department of Computer Science & Engineering for their involvement in the department and academic excellence.
honors.issuer: Issued by McKelvey School of Engineering · Apr 2019

honors.title: National AP Scholar
honors.description: According to the College Board, the title of National AP Scholar is "granted to students in the United States who receive an average score of at least 4 on all AP Exams taken, and scores of 4 or higher on eight or more of these exams."

volunteerExperiences.description:
Girls Who Code WashU is part of the national organization Girls Who Code. We strive to provide girls around the city of St. Louis with the opportunity to learn more about computer science in a fun and supportive environment.

As a co-founder and the communications chair for our WashU group, I help organize our group by recruiting new members - both volunteers and participants, perform administrative tasks and managing day-to-day items. As a facilitator, I meet with girls every week to help them create and work on projects that interest them.

organizations.name: Delta Gamma Fraternity - Alpha Epsilon
organizations.position: Director of Alumnae Relations · Jan 2017 - Present
organizations.description:
As an active member of Delta Gamma Fraternity, I participate in campus, philanthropy, and service events throughout the school year.

As Director of Alumnae Relations, I maintain contact with the local St. Louis alumnae group and former alumnae of our Alpha Epsilon chapter and help organize collumnae events.
